_comment: Exact versions of everything that goes into the standalone release packages.
Licence notices and source archives are collected for exactly these versions, so
change them only together (see README.md, section 'Release').
lxml/libiconv: libiconv version = lxml.etree.ICONV_COMPILED_VERSION; GCC: build id note of numpy.libs/libquadmath*.so.
project_url: repository whose release page offers the packages, the program's source archive and the LGPL/GPL sources ("download from the same place"); must match SOURCE_URL in abfindung/legal.py.

sources.name: qtbase-everywhere-src-6.9.3.tar.xz
sources.covers: Qt Core, Qt GUI, Qt Widgets, Qt D-Bus, Qt OpenGL, the platform integrations and the other Qt plugins (LGPL-3.0)

sources.name: qtsvg-everywhere-src-6.9.3.tar.xz
sources.covers: Qt SVG and the SVG plugins (LGPL-3.0)

sources.name: qtwayland-everywhere-src-6.9.3.tar.xz
sources.covers: Qt Wayland Client and the Wayland plugins (LGPL-3.0)

sources.name: type2-runtime-20251108.tar.gz
sources.covers: AppImage runtime (MIT) with the libfuse patch and the build scripts needed to rebuild it with a modified libfuse

sources.name: fuse-3.15.0.tar.xz
sources.covers: libfuse 3.15.0, statically linked into the AppImage runtime (LGPL-2.1)

sources.name: lxml-6.1.3.tar.gz
sources.covers: lxml 6.1.3 (BSD-3-Clause), whose etree module statically contains libiconv: rebuild it with a modified libiconv using buildlibxml.py

sources.name: libiconv-1.18.tar.gz
sources.covers: GNU libiconv 1.18, statically linked into lxml (LGPL-2.1)

sources.name: gcc-8.5.0-28.el8_10.alma.1.src.rpm
sources.covers: GCC 8.5.0 as built by AlmaLinux 8: source of libgfortran (GPL-3.0 WITH GCC-exception-3.1) and libquadmath (LGPL-2.1) in numpy.libs

sources.name: gcc-10.3.0.tar.xz
sources.covers: GCC 10.3.0: source of libgfortran (GPL-3.0 WITH GCC-exception-3.1), statically linked into numpy.libs/libscipy_openblas64_*.dll of the Windows packages
